name: Bob's Red Mill Organic Creamy Wheat Farina Cereal
whyItWorks: Made strictly from the tender inner endosperm of organic hard red wheat. Gently ground to create a velvety hot porridge with under 1g fiber per serving.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 3 tbsp in 1 cup water with a pinch of sea salt for 5 minutes on stovetop.
